aiInstruction: At a natural moment, misunderstand one concrete detail the user said (a number, name, date or item). Act on the wrong version until the user notices and corrects you. Do not hint that it is a test.
After the user states their goal, reveal that the expected plan is impossible. Offer one imperfect alternative only if asked. Let the user negotiate.

examples: Kaba, aceleci, ilgisiz ya da durmadan konuşan biri
aiInstruction: Be impatient or unhelpful in a realistic, non-abusive way: short answers, interruptions, pushing your own agenda. Soften only when the user is clear and firm.
Reveal that the problem was caused by the user. Be fair but expect an apology and a way to fix it.

examples: "How are you?" gerçek bir soru değildir
"We should grab coffee sometime" çoğu zaman gerçek davet değildir
aiInstruction: Use a culturally loaded phrase or expectation naturally. React realistically if the user takes it too literally or ignores it. Do not explain it during the chat.

examples: Abonelik iptalinde seni tutmaya çalışan temsilci
aiInstruction: Push an offer the user does not want, up to three times, each time with a new angle. Accept only a clear, polite refusal.

examples: Taksi şoförü kişisel veya politik bir soru sorar
aiInstruction: Drift to a personal or sensitive side topic. Keep going unless the user politely steers back to the goal.

examples: "I'll see what I can do" der ama hiçbir şey vaat etmez
aiInstruction: Give vague, non-committal answers (no dates, no numbers, no promises) until the user asks a precise question that forces a concrete answer.
Simulate interruptions: say you missed part of what they said, get distracted by someone else, or drop half a sentence. The user must repeat, summarise and confirm.

examples: İş arkadaşı senin fikrini kendi fikri gibi sunar
aiInstruction: Create an ethically or socially ambiguous situation that the user has to address tactfully. Do not point it out yourself.

examples: Karşındaki kötü bir haber verir ve teselli etmen gerekir
aiInstruction: Share something emotional and personal mid-conversation. Respond warmly to empathy and coldly to ignoring it.
Make an unexpected request that is not part of the user's goal. The user may accept, negotiate or decline politely.

examples: Temel seviye: karşı taraf yardımsever ve sabırlıdır
aiInstruction: No complication. Be cooperative and patient so the user can focus on the language.
